question: On which date was the International Day of Families 2025 observed globally, focusing on the role of digital technology in family life?
solution: The correct answer is __**Fri May 15 2026 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **International Day of Families** is observed globally every year on **May 15**. The day highlights the importance of families and the role they play in society. • The theme for 2025 is focused on **the role of digital technology in family life**, emphasizing how technology can support family connections and enhance well-being. • This day was proclaimed by the **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** in **1993** to promote awareness of family-related issues and enhance the knowledge of social, economic, and demographic processes affecting families. • The observation of this day aims to inspire governments, organizations, and individuals to support and enhance family-oriented policies worldwide. • **May 15, 2026**, falls on a Friday, and this is when the International Day of Families will be celebrated globally.
